resolution.description:
Why I did:

Fix: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/6761

How I did:

Make sure minigraph interface (Portchannel and Router Port) are not Backplane portchannel for crm interface.
As mention in issue minigraph will have backend portchannel but `show interface status` will only display frontend interfaces.
